create_WandBLogger: create a WandBLogger instance with a WandBLoggerConfig to initialize a W&B run for experiment tracking
log_metrics_with_WandBLogger: log a dictionary of metrics to the active W&B run using the logger log method
add_prefix_and_log_metrics: add a prefix to each metric key and log the prefixed metrics to W&B
use_stopwatch_context_manager: use the module-level stopwatch context manager to time and print the runtime of a code block
save_pickle_with_WandBLogger: save a Python object as a cloudpickle file to the logger's output directory
